offering_description.value: ICU Medical designs and builds infusion devices and safety software for hospitals and other healthcare providers. It also supplies pharmacy compounding, respiratory care, patient monitoring, perioperative, dialysis, and regional anesthesia equipment. It distributes injectable IV solutions manufactured by its joint venture and helps hospitals assess infusion safety.

quotes.quote: Lead a new wave of IV therapy performance with an intuitive platform designed to help bring safety, simplicity, and clarity to patient care. Comprised of Plum Duo ™ and Plum Solo ™ * precision IV pumps and LifeShield ™ IV safety software, this fully IV-EHR interoperable, future-ready platform empowers you to raise the performance of your IV therapy practice—helping to enhance safety and efficiency across all IV touchpoints.
IV Solutions are manufactured by Otsuka ICU Medical LLC and distributed by ICU Medical Sales, Inc. unless otherwise noted.

primary_products.value: IV pumps, lines, connectors, and safety software; injectable IV solutions; pharmacy compounding systems and drug transfer devices; respiratory and patient monitoring equipment; perioperative, dialysis, and regional anesthesia devices

quotes.quote: From IV lines to vital signs, we're with you at the heart of care.
A robust portfolio of intravenous solution options in flexible containers, including fluid and electrolyte replenishment, IV medication patient administration, and tamper- evident accessories.

quotes.quote: News / ICU Medical’s Infusion Assessment Program Earns INS Seal of Approval INS Seal of Approval recognizes ICU Medical’s Infusion Assessment Program as a trusted resource for helping hospitals improve infusion therapy safety and align with evidence-based best practices.
